lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a non-uniform grid posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal spot rows to form identifiable nodes on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal feature running across the upper third of the visible flank, showing a sharp vertical transition from high-intensity light to shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras (Echeneidae) are clearly visible as elongated dark silhouettes positioned directly beneath the pectoral fin.
